name: 3d-marquee

frames.best_why: The tilted photo wall fills the frame with its widest mix of subjects and the clearest diagonal grid.

tagline: Photos tile a tilted wall and drift up and down in columns.
summary: A gallery of many photos arranged in four columns on a rotated 3D plane, so the grid runs diagonally while neighbouring columns slide slowly in opposite directions.
appearance: Dozens of small landscape photos fill the frame as tilted diamonds, separated by thin dotted lines, showing tulips, a white ship, waves, a face and grass. The whole wall leans in perspective, larger toward one corner.
behaviour: Alternating columns creep vertically in opposite directions on long ten- and fifteen-second loops, so the wall drifts continuously. Hovering one photo lifts it a few pixels and adds a shadow.
demo_content: Landscape stock photos of red tulips, a white ship, crashing waves, a portrait and grassy fields.
use_when: A landing section wants a rich image wall behind or beside copy without inventing a layout.
avoid_when: The wall wants 32 images and moves forever, so it costs data and never stops for motion-sensitive visitors.
customise: Pass an array of image URLs and an optional className; column count, tilt, speeds and the 600px height are fixed in the source.
weight_why: Thirty-two images sit in four columns whose transforms animate non-stop.

a11y.note: Every photo has a bare 'Image 1' alt and the endless drift ignores reduced-motion.

issues: The rotated grid crops many photos into steep diamonds, so subjects are often cut off.
polish_why: Rich, immersive photo wall; the steep tilt crops many images into odd diamonds.
title: 3D Image Marquee
